changes.title: Crystal path rewards
changes.text: The two final crystal-path compartments now always contain Experience and Transmutation, one in each.

changes.title: Crystal reward generation checks
changes.text: Added checks across seeds, depths and exotic settings for both rewards and their two-key routes.

changes.title: Extreme statistics values
changes.text: Fixed malformed decimal displays for the smallest supported signed statistics value.

changes.title: Statistics number-formatting checks
changes.text: Added boundary-value checks and verified the existing formatter and query behavior.

changes.title: Verified investigation records
changes.text: Recorded the reward failure and seeded armor-generation findings without changing armor drop rates.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I corrected the crystal-path room so its two final rewards match the promised choices. Existing generated floors remain untouched.
